attempts.summary: Configured a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) allowing SSH from any address, allowing TCP/9000 only from node2, and rejecting TCP/9000 from node3 and all other sources via permanent priority-ordered rich rules. Verified functionally before and after restarting all three managed nodes one at a time, confirming rule persistence and correct accept/reject behavior throughout.
